description: This file implements the MessageUnit class, which handles serialization, updating, opening, closing, and message pushing functionalities within the Thunder::Messaging namespace. It manages message control handlers, interacts with message dispatchers, and handles environment setup and resource cleanup.

classes.name: MessageUnit
classes.description: Main class managing message serialization, control updates, and resource management within the messaging system.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes control data into a buffer, either for a specific module or all modules.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates control states based on provided metadata and settings.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageUnit.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes the MessageUnit, sets environment variables, creates necessary directories, and starts the dispatcher.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes redirected streams, and destroys the dispatcher.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Determines if a control should be enabled by default based on settings.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a message into the system, serializing it if necessary, or outputs directly.
